correction.description: v1 gradings corrupted by the attempt-CSV cache bug were replaced with fresh google/gemini-2.5-pro gradings run against the agents' real submitted workbooks (2026-08-03/04). Same judge, rubric 8, and weights as the original export.
correction.detection: scan_v1_extractions.py — an attempt is corrupted when the judge's archived CSV input contains <90% of the formulas present in the agent's submitted xlsx (broken <10%, partial 10-90%); only attempts with >=20 agent formulas are classified.
correction.new_row_field: corrected (bool) — true when grades come from the regrade
